component.name: Glafka
component.summary: A lightweight GNOME-native ebook library manager

description.p: Glafka keeps your ebooks in one tidy library on your computer and gets them onto your e-reader, by USB or by email. It needs no Calibre, but can import a Calibre library.

ul.li: Import EPUB and PDF files, whole folders, or a Calibre library
Browse by author, series and tag; edit details and covers
Copy books to a USB e-reader or email them, and see which are on it
